import {useQuery} from '@tanstack/solid-query'
import type {QueryClient} from '@tanstack/query-core'
import {usePlugin} from '@conciv/plugin/experimental'
import {Acme} from './rpc.js'

export function AcmeView(props: {client: QueryClient}) {
  const ctx = usePlugin()
  const found = useQuery(() => ctx.client.rpc(Acme).search.queryOptions({input: {query: 'a'}}), () => props.client)
  return <p>{String(found.data)}</p>
}
